subject: CWE-754
object: Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions
object_canonical: improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions

subject: CWE-754
object: The product does not check or incorrectly checks for unusual or exceptional conditions that are not expected to occur frequently during day to day operation of the product.
